subject.title: fix(xai): Grok subscription inference fails with HTTP 426 on every request

question: Should an operator-overridden xAI OAuth base URL receive the required static `x-grok-client-version` compatibility header?
rationale: The header is necessary for the hosted Grok OAuth proxy, but provider-level static headers follow the same configuration when users override its base URL; tests establish the intended standard routes, not the override contract.

options.title: Accept the scoped override behavior
options.body: Merge the OAuth-only header because it is non-secret, required by the vendor proxy, and correctly follows the provider route selected by the operator.

options.title: Add host-aware routing first
options.body: Preserve custom-base-URL flexibility while emitting the header only for the Grok OAuth proxy, with focused override coverage.

options.title: Pause pending provider-contract guidance
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define whether xAI OAuth overrides must behave as compatible Grok proxy endpoints or arbitrary third-party endpoints.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped override behavior
recommendation.body: Merge the OAuth-only header because it is non-secret, required by the vendor proxy, and correctly follows the provider route selected by the operator.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete OAuth-path analysis and can clarify the proposed operational contract, although current-main ownership history is not established.
